en: A vintage printed card from an insurance company with decorative black‑and‑white graphics at the top, including industrial scenes, a coat of arms and ornate lettering. Below is preprinted Finnish text with some handwritten insertions in blue ink. The layout and back‑printing style resemble an early‑20th‑century business postcard or payment reminder rather than a touristic view.
